name: revolution-chat
description: Secure real-time chat application built with React, TypeScript, Express, Socket.IO and SQLite.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c blue,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.dev:host: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c blue,green "npm run dev:host -w client" "npm run dev:host -w server"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.setup: npm install && node -e "require('fs').existsSync('server/.env')||require('fs').copyFileSync('server/.env.example','server/.env')" && npm run db:seed
